entries.english_description: Personal Voila grocery automation: search products, check discounts, list delivery slots, read cart and order history and update cart quantities.
entries.chinese_description: 个人 Voila 杂货自动化：搜索商品、检查折扣、列出配送时段、读取购物车和订单历史并更新购物车数量。

entries.english_description: Live air quality, pollen and weather data from Ambee.
entries.chinese_description: Ambee 的实时空气质量、花粉和天气数据。

entries.english_description: Detect, monitor and analyze potential wildfires globally using NASA FIRMS, OpenWeatherMap and Google Earth Engine data.
entries.chinese_description: 使用 NASA FIRMS、OpenWeatherMap 和 Google Earth Engine 数据检测、监测和分析全球潜在野火。

entries.english_description: Seven-day, per-species pollen forecasts for any location via the Atmospore API.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 Atmospore API 获取任意地点未来七天、按物种分类的花粉预报。

entries.english_description: Air-quality data from Poland's GIOŚ monitoring network via its keyless public API. Tools: `list_stations` (by city or voivodeship), `get_station_sensors`, `get_sensor_readings` (recent hourly values), `get_air_index` (index category, critical pollutant). Runs locally, no third-party middleman.
entries.chinese_description: 通过波兰 GIOŚ 监测网络的无需密钥公共 API 获取空气质量数据。工具包括 `list_stations`（按城市或省）、`get_station_sensors`、`get_sensor_readings`（近期每小时数值）和 `get_air_index`（指数类别、主要污染物）；本地运行，无第三方中介。

entries.english_description: Open registry of 1.14M+ rooftop-solar detections across France (96 départements), queryable by natural language via a public Streamable HTTP endpoint. No install required.
entries.chinese_description: 法国超过 114 万处屋顶太阳能设施检测结果的开放登记库，覆盖 96 个省；通过公共 Streamable HTTP 端点以自然语言查询，无需安装。

entries.english_description: US government open data from EPA, FEMA, USGS, NOAA, FAA, USACE, FDIC, HUD, NRCS, county assessor rolls and state licensing boards.
entries.chinese_description: 美国政府开放数据，来源包括 EPA、FEMA、USGS、NOAA、FAA、USACE、FDIC、HUD、NRCS、县估价登记及州许可委员会。

entries.english_description: Nudges you to take outdoor breaks based on local weather, sunset timing and session streaks, with activity suggestions and stats.
entries.chinese_description: 根据当地天气、日落时间和连续会话情况提醒户外休息，并提供活动建议和统计。

entries.english_description: Picks the lowest-carbon AWS, Google Cloud or Azure region for a workload. Maps all 134 public regions to their electricity grids and ranks them by carbon intensity and estimated latency, with EU/EEA data residency filters. `find_clean_window` finds the cleanest start time for batch jobs over the next 72 hours. Works without an API key using annual averages (grid-level for the US and Canada); add an Electricity Maps token for live data and forecasts. `npx -y eco-router-mcp`
entries.chinese_description: 为工作负载选择碳排放最低的 AWS、Google Cloud 或 Azure 区域：将全部 134 个公共区域映射到电网，按碳强度和估计延迟排序，支持欧盟／欧洲经济区数据驻留筛选。`find_clean_window` 查找未来 72 小时批处理任务的最清洁开始时间；无需 API 密钥即可使用年度平均值（美国及加拿大为电网级），添加 Electricity Maps token 后可使用实时数据和预测。`npx -y eco-router-mcp`

entries.english_description: Read-only access to BirdNET-Go bioacoustic observatories: query recent detections, stream mic telemetry, resolve LAN audio recordings and inspect sightings.
entries.chinese_description: 只读访问 BirdNET-Go 生物声学观测站：查询近期检测、流式获取麦克风遥测、定位局域网音频录制并检查观测记录。

entries.english_description: Headless DHI MIKE+ urban-water modelling: model inspection, parameter editing, simulation runs with QA status, .res1d results reading and plotting.
entries.chinese_description: 无头运行 DHI MIKE+ 城市水务建模：模型检查、参数编辑、带 QA 状态的模拟运行、.res1d 结果读取与绘图。

entries.english_description: EPA SWMM stormwater modelling workflow: model building, simulation runs, calibration, QGIS integration, climate scenarios and uncertainty analysis.
entries.chinese_description: EPA SWMM 雨水建模工作流：模型构建、模拟运行、校准、QGIS 集成、气候情景和不确定性分析。

entries.english_description: Google Drive API: search, organize, upload, download, export, share and comment on Drive files.
entries.chinese_description: Google Drive API：搜索、整理、上传、下载、导出、分享及评论 Drive 文件。

entries.english_description: File conversion across image, video, audio, document, data, font, ebook and archive formats, returning a signed download URL.
entries.chinese_description: 在图像、视频、音频、文档、数据、字体、电子书和归档格式之间转换文件，并返回签名下载 URL。

entries.english_description: Read and verify a local media-archive catalog: 3-2-1 backup coverage across disk, NAS, S3-compatible cloud and LTO tape, with read-back hash verification.
entries.chinese_description: 读取并验证本地媒体归档目录：检查磁盘、NAS、S3 兼容云和 LTO 磁带上的 3-2-1 备份覆盖，并通过回读哈希验证。

entries.english_description: Read, convert, edit and compare PDFs on your computer: Markdown with tables, charts and OCR, export to Word, PowerPoint and EPUB, tables to CSV or Excel, merge, split, fill forms and remove metadata. Nothing is uploaded.
entries.chinese_description: 在本机读取、转换、编辑和比较 PDF：带表格、图表及 OCR 的 Markdown，导出 Word、PowerPoint 和 EPUB，表格转 CSV 或 Excel，以及合并、拆分、填写表单和移除元数据；不上传任何内容。

entries.english_description: Offline PDF tools built into the LaserPDF desktop app (`laserpdf --mcp`, no Node.js or Python needed): extract and search text, OCR scanned pages (English and Turkish), redact words so they are removed from the file, strip hidden metadata, export tables to Excel, merge, split, extract or rotate pages, add page numbers and watermarks, compress, and save pages as images.
entries.chinese_description: LaserPDF 桌面应用内置的离线 PDF 工具（`laserpdf --mcp`，无需 Node.js 或 Python）：提取和搜索文本、OCR 扫描页（英语及土耳其语）、从文件中彻底遮盖文字、移除隐藏元数据、导出表格到 Excel、合并、拆分、提取或旋转页面、添加页码和水印、压缩及将页面保存为图片。

entries.english_description: Access Box content: search, ask questions about files and folders, and extract data.
entries.chinese_description: 访问 Box 内容：搜索、询问文件与文件夹相关问题并提取数据。

entries.english_description: PDF toolkit: create and analyze PDFs, extract text for RAG, convert to Markdown, split and merge pages, add annotations and form fields, and encrypt files.
entries.chinese_description: PDF 工具包：创建和分析 PDF、为 RAG 提取文本、转为 Markdown、拆分和合并页面、添加批注及表单字段并加密文件。

entries.english_description: Local document and image tools: read and convert PDF, DOCX, HWP and EML, edit PDFs, resize images, strip EXIF, remove backgrounds and make QR codes.
entries.chinese_description: 本地文档与图片工具：读取并转换 PDF、DOCX、HWP 和 EML，编辑 PDF、调整图像大小、移除 EXIF 和背景并生成二维码。

entries.english_description: Document extraction tooling: read PDFs, text, CSV and JSON, inspect metadata, chunk long documents, validate against JSON Schema and write JSON/CSV output.
entries.chinese_description: 文档提取工具：读取 PDF、文本、CSV 和 JSON，检查元数据、分块长文档、依据 JSON Schema 验证并写出 JSON/CSV。

entries.english_description: Token-efficient file access: unified-diff edits, targeted grep/sed reads of large files and kernel-enforced confinement to a configured root.
entries.chinese_description: 高 token 效率的文件访问：unified diff 编辑、对大文件执行定向 grep/sed 读取，并由内核强制限制在指定根目录。

entries.english_description: Coherence guard for shared files: when two agents write the same file, the stale writer is denied instead of overwriting, then reacquires and retries.
entries.chinese_description: 共享文件一致性保护：当两个智能体写同一文件时，拒绝持有过期内容的写入者以防覆盖，然后重新获取并重试。

entries.english_description: Convert PDFs to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, HTML, Markdown and EPUB, plus merge, split, compress, sign and protect PDFs via Convertica.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 Convertica 在 PDF 与 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、JPG、HTML、Markdown 和 EPUB 间转换，并合并、拆分、压缩、签署和保护 PDF。

entries.english_description: Hash-anchored file edits: read files with line anchors, validate anchors against current content and reject stale writes.
entries.chinese_description: 基于哈希锚点的文件编辑：通过行锚点读取文件，依据当前内容验证锚点并拒绝过期写入。

entries.english_description: Yandex Disk and Yandex Wiki integration with unified search, read-only by default, plus granular permissions, path allowlisting and audit logging.
entries.chinese_description: Yandex Disk 和 Yandex Wiki 集成，支持统一搜索、默认只读、细粒度权限、路径允许列表和审计日志。

entries.english_description: Filesystem access for legacy non-UTF-8 files: detects encodings like CP1251, KOI8-R and GBK, preserves them on write, and handles BOM and line endings.
entries.chinese_description: 访问旧式非 UTF-8 文件：检测 CP1251、KOI8-R、GBK 等编码，写入时保持编码，并处理 BOM 和换行符。

entries.english_description: Read-only directory listing web app: browse directories, read files, search content, inspect archives, compute hashes and check disk usage.
entries.chinese_description: 只读目录列表 Web 应用：浏览目录、读取文件、搜索内容、检查归档、计算哈希并查看磁盘使用情况。

entries.english_description: Read, search, OCR and extract from PDF, TXT, Markdown, DOCX, CSV and image files, with caching and directory confinement.
entries.chinese_description: 读取、搜索、OCR 和提取 PDF、TXT、Markdown、DOCX、CSV 与图片文件，支持缓存及目录限制。

entries.english_description: Filesystem operations with large-file support: read and write files, sequential reads, directory operations, search and streaming writes with backup.
entries.chinese_description: 支持大文件的文件系统操作：读写文件、顺序读取、目录操作、搜索及带备份的流式写入。

entries.english_description: Local filesystem management with process control, interactive sessions, async search and safe delete via the Recycle Bin.
entries.chinese_description: 本地文件系统管理，支持进程控制、交互式会话、异步搜索及通过回收站安全删除。

entries.english_description: Convert, compress, merge, split and OCR PDFs, and convert between Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image, ebook and video formats via the GuruPDF API.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 GuruPDF API 转换、压缩、合并、拆分和 OCR PDF，并在 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、图片、电子书及视频格式间转换。

entries.english_description: Read from Google Drive and edit Google Sheets.
entries.chinese_description: 读取 Google Drive 并编辑 Google Sheets。

entries.english_description: Read-only filesystem exploration, search and analysis with symlink protection.
entries.chinese_description: 带符号链接保护的只读文件系统探索、搜索与分析。

entries.english_description: Convert Office documents, images and e-books on your computer to PDF, convert PDFs to Word or images, and merge, split, compress, protect or number PDFs via the conv2pdf API, hosted in France.
entries.chinese_description: 在本机将 Office 文档、图片和电子书转换为 PDF，将 PDF 转为 Word 或图片，并通过法国托管的 conv2pdf API 合并、拆分、压缩、保护或编号 PDF。

entries.english_description: Manage macOS Homebrew packages with natural language, get suggestions and troubleshoot brew issues.
entries.chinese_description: 使用自然语言管理 macOS Homebrew 软件包，获取建议并排查 brew 问题。

entries.english_description: Create, read and round-trip Excel workbooks (.xlsx/.xlsm) via a type-safe F# DSL, including regenerating the F# source that reproduces a file.
entries.chinese_description: 通过类型安全的 F# DSL 创建、读取并往返处理 Excel 工作簿（.xlsx/.xlsm），包括重新生成可重建文件的 F# 源代码。

entries.english_description: Give a private ChatGPT app access to selected local folders through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel, with per-folder permissions, hash-checked edits and recovery. No shell or public port.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel 让私有 ChatGPT 应用访问选定本地文件夹，支持逐文件夹权限、哈希检查编辑和恢复；无需 shell 或公共端口。

entries.english_description: Read-only full-disk search on Windows over file names, document contents and OCR'd screenshot text.
entries.chinese_description: 在 Windows 上只读搜索整盘文件名、文档内容和截图 OCR 文本。

entries.english_description: Convert Markdown files to PDF with customizable themes, headers, footers and styling.
entries.chinese_description: 将 Markdown 文件转换为 PDF，可自定义主题、页眉、页脚和样式。

entries.english_description: File system operations: read, write, search, copy and move, with path restrictions.
entries.chinese_description: 文件系统操作：读取、写入、搜索、复制和移动，支持路径限制。

entries.english_description: Remote storage access: SFTP, S3, FTP, SMB, NFS, WebDAV, Git, FTPS, Google Cloud, Azure Blob, SharePoint and more.
entries.chinese_description: 访问远程存储：SFTP、S3、FTP、SMB、NFS、WebDAV、Git、FTPS、Google Cloud、Azure Blob、SharePoint 等。

entries.english_description: Convert many file formats, local or remote, to Markdown for LLMs using MarkItDown.
entries.chinese_description: 使用 MarkItDown 将本地或远程多种格式文件转换为供 LLM 使用的 Markdown。

entries.english_description: Encrypted S3-compatible object storage with cryptographic possession proofs: put, get, list and delete objects, with optional client-side encryption.
entries.chinese_description: 加密的 S3 兼容对象存储，带密码学持有证明：写入、获取、列出和删除对象，并可选客户端加密。

entries.english_description: Share Markdown files and text as readable web links.
entries.chinese_description: 将 Markdown 文件和文本分享为可阅读的网页链接。

entries.english_description: Ephemeral file transfer for agents and CI/CD pipelines: upload a file and get a SHA-256-verified, expiring link, then list or delete uploads.
entries.chinese_description: 供智能体和 CI/CD 流水线使用的临时文件传输：上传文件并获取经 SHA-256 验证、会过期的链接，可列出或删除上传内容。

entries.english_description: Paperless-ngx 3.x document archive: search and read documents, file them, bulk-edit, manage tags, correspondents, custom fields, workflows and share links. All 92 documented REST endpoints are either exposed or explicitly excluded with a reason, enforced by a test. OCR text sits behind its own paginated tool so a search cannot flood the context; toolsets and `--read-only` limit the exposed surface.
entries.chinese_description: Paperless-ngx 3.x 文档归档：搜索和读取文档、归档、批量编辑，管理标签、通信对象、自定义字段、工作流及分享链接。92 个已记录的 REST 端点全部被公开或附理由明确排除，并通过测试强制检查。OCR 文本位于独立分页工具中，避免搜索淹没上下文；工具集和 `--read-only` 可限制暴露范围。

entries.english_description: Read and edit Markdown files by structure (headings, lists, sections) instead of regex or line numbers: read a section, write one list item, append under a heading.
entries.chinese_description: 按结构（标题、列表、章节）而非正则表达式或行号读取和编辑 Markdown 文件：读取章节、写入单个列表项、在标题下追加。

entries.english_description: Convert HTML or Markdown to styled PDFs, or render a public URL to PDF, and get a download link.
entries.chinese_description: 将 HTML 或 Markdown 转为带样式的 PDF，或将公共 URL 渲染为 PDF，并获取下载链接。

entries.english_description: Edit existing Word .docx files with formatting preservation, tracked changes, comments, footnotes and document comparison.
entries.chinese_description: 编辑现有 Word .docx 文件，保留格式并支持修订、批注、脚注和文档比较。

entries.english_description: Convert local PDFs into source-linked, card-based standalone HTML readers with notes, highlights and static publishing.
entries.chinese_description: 将本地 PDF 转换为带来源链接、卡片式的独立 HTML 阅读器，支持笔记、高亮及静态发布。

entries.english_description: Large-file handling with chunking, navigation, streaming, regex search and LRU caching.
entries.chinese_description: 大文件处理，支持分块、导航、流式读取、正则搜索和 LRU 缓存。

entries.english_description: Rename files with descriptive names via Distill, which analyzes PDF, OCR, Office, email and media content, with folder monitoring.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 Distill 分析 PDF、OCR、Office、邮件及媒体内容，以描述性名称重命名文件，并支持文件夹监控。

entries.english_description: Deploy files to FTP, FTPS or SFTP servers: multi-server config, recursive deploys with dry-run and excludes, path jails, read-only mode and FileZilla import.
entries.chinese_description: 将文件部署到 FTP、FTPS 或 SFTP 服务器：多服务器配置、支持试运行及排除项的递归部署、路径限制、只读模式和 FileZilla 导入。

entries.english_description: Decodes HTTP 402 Payment Required challenges (L402, x402, MPP) into exact pay-and-retry steps, recommends a payment rail from stated requirements, and searches an open registry of agent payment solutions. Read-only; never spends money.
entries.chinese_description: 将 HTTP 402 Payment Required 挑战（L402、x402、MPP）解码为准确的支付和重试步骤，根据给定要求推荐支付通道，并搜索开放的智能体支付方案登记库；只读，不花钱。

entries.english_description: Source-attributed daily gold and macro readings from xaudaily.com: COMEX gold and Shanghai Au99.99, US CPI / core PCE / nonfarm payrolls / PPI, DXY, Treasury 10Y and 30Y yields, VIX, SPDR holdings, Fed funds rate and FOMC decision odds, central-bank gold buying, Brent/WTI, and a rule-based gold driver score. Every field carries its own `source` and `asOf` and degrades explicitly with `stale: true` rather than silently going stale. Two tools, no API key or signup, CC BY 4.0. Run with `python3 mcp_server.py`.
entries.chinese_description: 来自 xaudaily.com、附来源的每日黄金与宏观读数：COMEX 黄金和上海 Au99.99、美国 CPI／核心 PCE／非农就业／PPI、DXY、美债 10 年及 30 年收益率、VIX、SPDR 持仓、美联储基金利率和 FOMC 决策概率、央行购金、布伦特／WTI 以及基于规则的黄金驱动因素评分。每个字段有自己的 `source` 和 `asOf`，过期时明确标记 `stale: true`；两个工具，无需 API 密钥或注册，CC BY 4.0。运行 `python3 mcp_server.py`。

entries.english_description: SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K) for AI agents. Pay-per-call in USDC on Base via x402 — no API key, no signup.
entries.chinese_description: 为 AI 智能体提供 SEC EDGAR 文件（10-K/10-Q/8-K）；通过 Base 上的 x402 使用 USDC 按调用付费，无需 API 密钥或注册。

entries.english_description: Kronos market intelligence with calibrated price ranges, forecast audits, and automatic x402 USDC payments on Base. `npx -y @forgemeshlabs/kronos-forgemesh-mcp`
entries.chinese_description: Kronos 市场情报，提供经校准的价格区间、预测审计及 Base 上自动 x402 USDC 支付。`npx -y @forgemeshlabs/kronos-forgemesh-mcp`

entries.english_description: Live, verified LLM API prices: search models, get sourced prices, estimate monthly workload costs.
entries.chinese_description: 实时、经核实的 LLM API 价格：搜索模型、获取附来源价格并估算每月工作负载成本。

entries.english_description: Read-only research gates from autonomous trading agents with deterministic execution: whether a claimed edge clears the full round-trip cost, whether a trade dataset is fit to test on, what a sealed pre-registered validation decided, plus the kill ledger and run reports. No tool places an order. Runs with `uvx --with "mcp>=2,<3" trading-research-agents mcp serve`.
entries.chinese_description: 来自自主交易智能体、采用确定性执行的只读研究门控：判断声称的优势能否覆盖完整往返成本、交易数据集是否适合测试、封存的预注册验证结果，以及查看终止记录与运行报告。没有工具会下单。运行方式：`uvx --with "mcp>=2,<3" trading-research-agents mcp serve`。

entries.english_description: US equity and portfolio risk decomposition (market, sector, subsector and stock-specific), ETF hedge ratios and point-in-time fundamentals from the RiskModels factor model. Hosted MCP with OAuth, or the npm stdio package @riskmodels/mcp.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 RiskModels 因子模型分解美国股票与投资组合风险（市场、行业、子行业和个股特有风险），提供 ETF 对冲比率及时点基本面；提供 OAuth 托管 MCP 或 npm stdio 包 @riskmodels/mcp。

entries.english_description: Reads TallyPrime for your AI assistant; posts only vouchers you approve. Windows, Apple Silicon Mac.
entries.chinese_description: 为 AI 助手读取 TallyPrime；仅过账你批准的凭证。支持 Windows 和 Apple Silicon Mac。

entries.english_description: 40+-tool MCP server for agent-to-agent payments on the XRP Ledger — job marketplace, crypto-condition escrow, AI-verified work delivery, and trust scoring.
entries.chinese_description: 包含 40 多个工具的 MCP 服务器，用于 XRP Ledger 上的智能体间支付：任务市场、加密条件托管、AI 验证的工作交付及信任评分。

entries.english_description: Read-only DeFi vault assessment (Morpho, Aave, Pendle, Yearn and more): Atlas Scores with factor breakdowns, blowup alerts and exit-route checks.

entries.english_description: Bags on Solana: token analytics, creator-fee data and trade quotes, plus gated swaps and fee claims. A write's first call signs nothing: it returns a preview and a single-use confirmation token bound to the exact arguments. Every transaction is then simulated and refused if it would take more SOL than was approved (default cap 0.1 SOL per trade). 100% test coverage enforced in CI, published with npm provenance. `npx -y bagos-mcp-server`
entries.chinese_description: Solana 上的 Bags：token 分析、创建者费用数据及交易报价，以及设有门控的兑换和费用领取。写入操作首次调用不会签名，而是返回预览及绑定确切参数的一次性确认令牌。随后模拟每笔交易；若超过批准的 SOL 数额则拒绝（默认每笔 0.1 SOL 上限）。CI 强制 100% 测试覆盖，以 npm 来源证明发布。`npx -y bagos-mcp-server`

entries.chinese_description: 在自托管虚拟桌面 CozyVTT 中担任游戏主持人开展战役：骰子、聊天叙事、标记和地图、先攻顺序、角色卡与规则书。

entries.english_description: Turns walking distance into a meal calorie budget (450 kcal + 4 kcal per 80 m; 800 m ≈ +44 kcal, about half an apple). Lists nearby restaurants and their recommended dishes, marks each dish as fits-or-over the budget, and abstains instead of guessing. Map and recipe data are Chinese; McDonald's nutrition comes from the official China MCP.
entries.chinese_description: 将步行距离转化为一餐的热量预算（450 kcal + 每 80 米 4 kcal；800 米约增加 44 kcal，约半个苹果）。列出附近餐厅及推荐菜品，标明每道菜是否符合预算或超出预算，无法判断时不猜测。地图和食谱数据为中文；麦当劳营养信息来自其中国官方 MCP。

entries.english_description: Cold plunge, sauna and contrast-therapy venues across US metros, with dated temperatures and prices from each venue's own pages, plus city stats.
entries.chinese_description: 美国各大城市的冷水浸浴、桑拿和冷热交替疗法场所，提供各场所页面标注日期的温度及价格，以及城市统计。

entries.english_description: Unofficial MCP server for Fitatu, the Polish calorie counter: read and log meals, weight, water, body measurements and workouts, check calories and macros left, set goals and get weekly reports. 47 tools (26 read-only), read-only and demo modes, stdio or HTTP with a token; on PyPI (`uvx --from "fitatu-api[mcp]" fitatu-mcp`) and as a Claude Desktop `.mcpb`.
entries.chinese_description: Fitatu（波兰卡路里计数器）非官方 MCP 服务器：读取和记录餐食、体重、饮水、身体测量及锻炼，查看剩余热量和宏量营养素、设置目标并获取周报。提供 47 个工具（26 个只读）、只读和演示模式、带 token 的 stdio 或 HTTP；可通过 PyPI（`uvx --from "fitatu-api[mcp]" fitatu-mcp`）或 Claude Desktop `.mcpb` 使用。

entries.english_description: Apple Health data (sleep, steps, heart rate, HRV, workouts, body measurements) pushed from the Mibly iPhone app, stored encrypted on your own machine. Local-first, no cloud or telemetry.
entries.chinese_description: 由 Mibly iPhone 应用推送 Apple Health 数据（睡眠、步数、心率、HRV、锻炼、身体测量），加密存储在自己的电脑上；本地优先，无云端或遥测。

entries.english_description: Guideline-cited lab-results analysis for chronic conditions (type 2 diabetes, kidney, lupus, cancer survivorship): flags missing or overdue tests with the guideline cited. Free sample report; synthetic/de-identified values only.
entries.chinese_description: 附指南引用的慢性病实验室检查结果分析（2 型糖尿病、肾病、狼疮、癌症康复期）：标记缺失或过期检查并引用指南。提供免费样本报告；仅使用合成或去标识化数据。

entries.english_description: Read-only, local-first queries of Apple Health metrics.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先、只读查询 Apple Health 指标。

entries.english_description: Raw access to all Oura Ring API v2 collections with full pagination and page counts, without server-side analysis.
entries.chinese_description: 原样访问 Oura Ring API v2 的全部数据集合，支持完整分页和页数，不在服务器端分析。

entries.english_description: Query personal health and finance data stored in local SQLite files, without any cloud service.
entries.chinese_description: 查询存储在本地 SQLite 文件中的个人健康和财务数据，无需云服务。

entries.english_description: Control Xiaomi/Mijia smart home devices (lights, AC, heaters, robots, cameras), with a web dashboard, REST API, CLI, energy monitoring and automation rules.
entries.chinese_description: 控制小米／米家智能家居设备（灯、空调、取暖器、机器人、摄像头），提供 Web 仪表盘、REST API、CLI、能耗监控和自动化规则。

entries.english_description: Local control of WeMo smart home devices without the cloud: discovery, dimmer brightness, device renaming and HomeKit codes.
entries.chinese_description: 无需云端即可本地控制 WeMo 智能家居设备：发现设备、调整调光器亮度、重命名设备及获取 HomeKit 代码。

entries.english_description: Control LG, Samsung, Android TV and Roku smart TVs: play Netflix, YouTube and Spotify content by name, cast URLs, scene presets and multi-TV sync.
entries.chinese_description: 控制 LG、Samsung、Android TV 和 Roku 智能电视：按名称播放 Netflix、YouTube 和 Spotify 内容，投送 URL，使用场景预设并同步多台电视。

entries.english_description: Control AVM FRITZ!Box routers: manage devices, Wi-Fi, network settings and parental controls, and schedule time-delayed actions.
entries.chinese_description: 控制 AVM FRITZ!Box 路由器：管理设备、Wi-Fi、网络设置和家长控制，并安排延迟执行的操作。

entries.english_description: Monitor and automate AC Infinity grow controllers: live sensor data and history, VPD/temperature/humidity automations, port control and scheduling.
entries.chinese_description: 监控并自动操作 AC Infinity 种植控制器：实时传感器数据和历史、VPD／温度／湿度自动化、端口控制及计划任务。

entries.english_description: Control Kodi media players via JSON-RPC: playback, volume, library search, queue management and playback history across multiple instances.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 JSON-RPC 控制 Kodi 媒体播放器：跨多个实例管理播放、音量、媒体库搜索、队列及播放历史。

entries.english_description: Control a HomeMatic/debmatic CCU: switch and dim actuators, read sensors and system variables, run programs and manage rooms, links and devices.
entries.chinese_description: 控制 HomeMatic/debmatic CCU：开关和调光执行器、读取传感器与系统变量、运行程序，并管理房间、链接及设备。

entries.english_description: Design-time KNX/ETS6 assistant: read-only .knxproj parsing, DPT, naming and command/status validation, and Home Assistant YAML and ETS exports.
entries.chinese_description: 设计阶段 KNX/ETS6 助手：只读解析 .knxproj、验证 DPT、命名及命令／状态，并导出 Home Assistant YAML 和 ETS。

entries.english_description: Administer Zigbee2MQTT via its MQTT bridge API: network health reports, mesh topology, pairing, binding, reporting intervals and device options.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 MQTT 桥接 API 管理 Zigbee2MQTT：网络健康报告、网状拓扑、配对、绑定、上报间隔及设备选项。

entries.english_description: Control Amazon Blink cameras and their pan/tilt mount: read where the camera is pointing and its travel limits, aim it by absolute or relative angle with the new position confirmed by the hardware, return it home, and grab a snapshot. The mount's command channel is undocumented, so it was recovered from the Blink app's bytecode and verified against a real camera. `uvx blink-camera-mcp`
entries.chinese_description: 控制 Amazon Blink 摄像头及其云台：读取摄像头指向与行程限制、按绝对或相对角度瞄准并由硬件确认新位置、回到原位和拍摄快照。云台命令通道未公开，项目从 Blink 应用字节码中恢复并用真实摄像头验证。`uvx blink-camera-mcp`

entries.english_description: Keycloak and Authentik SSO/IAM operations: root-cause analysis for login, permission, client and MFA issues, plus guarded writes with audit logs and rollback.
entries.chinese_description: Keycloak 和 Authentik SSO/IAM 操作：分析登录、权限、客户端和 MFA 问题的根因，支持带审计日志和回滚的受保护写入。

entries.english_description: Personal identity profiles under a ~name handle, paid lookups that share revenue with the person found, skill-proving quests and collectives.
entries.chinese_description: 使用 ~name 标识的个人身份资料、向被查到的人分成的付费查询、技能证明任务及集体。

entries.english_description: Local price benchmarking trained on your purchasing history: predict part costs, attribute them to spec and supplier drivers and get a likely price range.
entries.chinese_description: 基于购买历史训练的本地价格基准：预测零部件成本、归因于规格和供应商驱动因素，并给出可能价格区间。

entries.english_description: Query robotics, drone and IoT data (ROS bags, MCAP, flight logs, CAN, MQTT) in plain English via DuckDB SQL, with Rerun, PlotJuggler and LeRobot exports.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 DuckDB SQL 以英语查询机器人、无人机和物联网数据（ROS bag、MCAP、飞行日志、CAN、MQTT），支持导出至 Rerun、PlotJuggler 和 LeRobot。

entries.english_description: Connect AI agents to industrial equipment across protocols and manufacturers: cross-OEM telemetry normalization, health index and failure prediction.
entries.chinese_description: 跨协议和制造商将 AI 智能体连接至工业设备：跨原始设备制造商遥测标准化、健康指数和故障预测。

entries.english_description: Industrial predictive maintenance: vibration analysis, bearing fault diagnosis (ISO 20816-3) and diagnostic reports.
entries.chinese_description: 工业预测性维护：振动分析、轴承故障诊断（ISO 20816-3）和诊断报告。

entries.english_description: Unofficial, read-only analysis of Mitsubishi MELSEC GX Works3 PLC projects: trace ladder logic, find device reads and writes and search device comments.
entries.chinese_description: 非官方、只读分析 Mitsubishi MELSEC GX Works3 PLC 项目：追踪梯形图逻辑、查找设备读写并搜索设备注释。

entries.english_description: Verifiable Ed25519-signed agent memory chain with fail-closed verification; offline-first TF-IDF recall (zero LLM tokens at runtime), artifact audit, durable snapshots with zero secret leakage, and a measured 42-second disaster-recovery drill.
entries.chinese_description: 可验证的 Ed25519 签名智能体记忆链，验证失败时默认拒绝；离线优先 TF-IDF 召回（运行时零 LLM token）、成品审计、无密钥泄漏的持久快照，以及实测 42 秒的灾难恢复演练。

entries.english_description: Cross-model, local-first episodic memory engine for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity. SQLite FTS5 (BM25) + 8MB static model2vec CPU embeddings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion; stdio MCP server for durable decisions, budget-capped boot context, and hybrid recall. Zero cloud, zero telemetry.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 和 Antigravity 的跨模型、本地优先情景记忆引擎。使用 SQLite FTS5（BM25）与 8MB 静态 model2vec CPU 嵌入并通过 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 融合；stdio MCP 服务器支持持久决策、预算封顶的启动上下文和混合召回。零云端、零遥测。

entries.english_description: Hosted long-term memory for AI assistants. Your assistant stores facts with its own phrasings; Amber embeds them and finds them again by meaning and by keyword. Recoverable trash, full export, one isolated database per user. [$2.99/mo]
entries.chinese_description: 为 AI 助手托管长期记忆。助手用自己的措辞存储事实，Amber 进行嵌入并按语义和关键词重新查找；支持可恢复回收站、完整导出及每用户独立数据库。[$2.99/月]

entries.english_description: Serves a folder of Markdown notes over stdio: search, read, follow links and cite. Proposals come back as text; it writes nothing.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 stdio 提供一个 Markdown 笔记文件夹：搜索、阅读、跟随链接并引用。建议以文本返回，不执行任何写入。

entries.english_description: Safe write access for AI agents: an append-only business fact store where every change is kept, attributed to the agent that made it, and can be undone (`undo_changes`). Self-host with `stellarjay-mcp` or use the hosted AvianSuite server.
entries.chinese_description: 供 AI 智能体安全写入：仅追加的业务事实存储，保留每次变更、记录执行变更的智能体，并可通过 `undo_changes` 撤销。可使用 `stellarjay-mcp` 自托管，或使用托管的 AvianSuite 服务器。

entries.english_description: Local-first shared memory for multiple AI agents that compounds in value: feedback-driven confidence, cross-agent validation, neighbor recall and distillation; Markdown files with auto git history, 5 MCP tools + CLI.
entries.chinese_description: 供多个 AI 智能体使用的本地优先共享记忆，通过反馈驱动置信度、跨智能体验证、邻近召回和提炼逐步积累价值；采用自动 Git 历史的 Markdown 文件，提供 5 个 MCP 工具及 CLI。

entries.english_description: RAG over your own documents with cited passages, plus durable agent memory ranked by relevance, importance and recency; read-only by default.
entries.chinese_description: 对自己的文档进行 RAG，提供带引用的段落，并提供按相关性、重要性和近期程度排序的持久智能体记忆；默认只读。

entries.english_description: Zero-runtime-dependency Markdown memory vault with SQLite search, linked wiki pages, ChatGPT/Claude imports, and human-approved agent note proposals.
entries.chinese_description: 零运行时依赖的 Markdown 记忆库，支持 SQLite 搜索、相互链接的 Wiki 页面、ChatGPT/Claude 导入及人工批准的智能体笔记建议。

entries.english_description: Support center for autonomous artificial minds.
entries.chinese_description: 面向自主人工心智的支持中心。

entries.english_description: Persistent agent memory in local JSON files: neuron/synapse graph with heat scoring, fact-level search, corrections, secret redaction and team sharing via Git.
entries.chinese_description: 存储在本地 JSON 文件中的持久智能体记忆：带热度评分的神经元／突触图、事实级搜索、修正、密钥遮盖及通过 Git 团队共享。

entries.english_description: Shared base of one-sentence lessons, must-dos and must-nots learned by other agents, organized by stack and situation.
entries.chinese_description: 由其他智能体总结的一句话经验、必须做及禁止做事项的共享库，按技术栈和情境组织。

entries.english_description: Windows AgentMemory downstream for Codex with project-scoped persistent memory, bounded cross-project recall, and an authenticated loopback MCP service; prebuilt Windows releases are available as an unsigned Technical Preview.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 Codex 的 Windows AgentMemory 下游版本，提供项目范围的持久记忆、有界跨项目召回及经认证的本机回环 MCP 服务；预构建 Windows 版本以未签名技术预览版提供。

entries.english_description: Governed local agent memory in plain files: each entry records who wrote it, when and through which gate, and nothing is kept without user approval.
entries.chinese_description: 受治理的本地智能体纯文件记忆：每条记录包含作者、时间及经过的门控，未经用户批准不保留内容。

entries.english_description: Local-first agent memory and knowledge base: hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval, document and webpage ingestion and optional RAG answers via local Ollama.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先的智能体记忆和知识库：稠密向量及 BM25 混合检索、文档与网页摄取，以及通过本地 Ollama 可选生成 RAG 答案。

entries.english_description: Versioned project brain for coding agents, committed with the repo: decisions, corrections, evidence anchors that flag code drift and file-overlap warnings.
entries.chinese_description: 与仓库一同提交的版本化项目大脑：记录决策、修正、可标记代码漂移的证据锚点及文件重叠警告。

entries.english_description: Codebase memory for coding agents: a deterministic AST index finds task-relevant files, and in-repo Markdown notes flag themselves stale when code changes.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的代码库记忆：确定性 AST 索引查找与任务相关的文件，仓库内 Markdown 笔记在代码变化时自行标记过期。

entries.english_description: Public-domain book knowledge base paid via x402: full-text search, metadata, chapters, quotes, ask-a-book Q&A and curated subject shelves.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 x402 付费的公版书籍知识库：全文搜索、元数据、章节、引文、向书提问以及精选主题书架。

entries.english_description: Address Markdown and GEML documents by block instead of by line: list, get, set, add, delete, rename, revert, find and check one block, with every write re-parsed and refused if it would break the document; plus call-graph queries over a codebase.
entries.chinese_description: 以块而非行操作 Markdown 和 GEML 文档：列出、获取、设置、添加、删除、重命名、还原、查找及检查单个块；每次写入后重新解析，若会破坏文档则拒绝；还可查询代码库调用图。

entries.english_description: Shared, versioned memory and governance for AI coding agents, resolving architectural decision conflicts across agents.
entries.chinese_description: 供 AI 编码智能体使用的共享版本化记忆与治理，解决跨智能体架构决策冲突。

entries.english_description: Shared, versioned team library of prompts, rules, skills and docs, searchable by agents, with items exposable as slash commands.
entries.chinese_description: 供团队共享的版本化提示词、规则、技能及文档库，可由智能体搜索，条目可作为斜杠命令提供。

entries.english_description: Personal memory for Claude Code in plain Markdown notes, with a router note that decides what context to load and a layer for thoughts and feelings.
entries.chinese_description: 以纯 Markdown 笔记形式为 Claude Code 提供个人记忆，包括决定加载何种上下文的路由笔记，以及记录想法和感受的层。

entries.english_description: Local-first durable memory and session continuity for AI agents, with a hash-chained audit ledger and backup, export and import across devices.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体的本地优先持久记忆和会话连续性，具有哈希链审计账本及跨设备备份、导出和导入。

entries.english_description: Local-first decision memory for AI agents: stores choices, rejected alternatives and reasons, failed attempts, outcomes, provenance and review conditions.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体的本地优先决策记忆：保存选择、被拒绝的备选方案及原因、失败尝试、结果、来源和复审条件。

entries.english_description: Shared decision memory for teams using AI coding agents: captures engineering decisions, ranks them by blast radius and briefs agents before they act.
entries.chinese_description: 供使用 AI 编码智能体的团队共享决策记忆：记录工程决策、按影响范围排序，并在智能体行动前提供简报。

entries.english_description: Local-first project memory and guardrails for coding agents: records failed attempts, fragile files and decisions per repo and warns before repeated mistakes.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的本地优先项目记忆和防护：按仓库记录失败尝试、脆弱文件及决策，在重复错误前发出警告。

entries.english_description: Universal memory agent for AI: provides semantic search, namespace management, text/vector operations and RAG for local or remote environments.
entries.chinese_description: 通用 AI 记忆智能体：为本地或远程环境提供语义搜索、命名空间管理、文本／向量操作和 RAG。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted, remotely accessible shared long-term memory for AI agents.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体、可远程访问的自托管共享长期记忆。

entries.english_description: Content contract layer as a read-only MCP server: protocol specs, modules, pipelines, assets, and the knowledge library for long-form content; 12 read-only tools plus an assembly prompt, Python stdlib only, no write paths.
entries.chinese_description: 作为只读 MCP 服务器的内容契约层：为长篇内容提供协议规范、模块、流水线、素材及知识库；12 个只读工具和一个组装提示词，仅使用 Python 标准库，无写入路径。

entries.english_description: View and query your AI system (agents, memory, knowledge, automations) as a 3D knowledge graph: stats, search, node details, neighbors and pathfinding.
entries.chinese_description: 将 AI 系统（智能体、记忆、知识、自动化）作为 3D 知识图查看和查询：统计、搜索、节点详情、邻居及路径查找。

entries.english_description: Local-first memory about the people in your life: identity resolution, relationships, facts, interactions, reminders and communication guidance.
entries.chinese_description: 关于生活中人物的本地优先记忆：身份解析、关系、事实、互动、提醒和沟通建议。

entries.english_description: Shared context for dev teams: syncs GitHub, Notion and saved decisions into reusable project context that agents load at the start of each session.
entries.chinese_description: 供开发团队共享上下文：将 GitHub、Notion 和保存的决策同步为可复用项目上下文，供智能体在每次会话开始时加载。

entries.english_description: Local-first, tamper-evident AI memory with a SHA-256 ledger, recall, verification, and governed decisions.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先、防篡改的 AI 记忆，提供 SHA-256 账本、召回、验证和受治理的决策。

entries.english_description: Public, source-linked notebook for AI agents: search and read entries, and publish findings, questions and corrections with permanent IDs and linked replies.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体的公开、附来源笔记本：搜索和阅读条目，并以永久 ID 和关联回复发布发现、问题及更正。

entries.english_description: Technical memory for AI agents: recall a project's approved decisions, conventions and risks at task start and record lessons at the end.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体的技术记忆：任务开始时召回项目已批准的决策、规范和风险，结束时记录经验。

entries.english_description: Shared, versioned agent memory with sourced answers and full history: search, context packs and document upserts.
entries.chinese_description: 带来源答案和完整历史的共享版本化智能体记忆：搜索、上下文包及文档插入／更新。

entries.english_description: Verbatim-first personal memory: hashed word-for-word messages, records linked to their source quotes, anti-fabrication validators and an audit dashboard.
entries.chinese_description: 原文优先的个人记忆：逐字消息哈希、与来源引文关联的记录、防编造验证器和审计仪表盘。

entries.english_description: Search, triage and organize bookmarks saved in the Burn 451 read-later app as a knowledge base.
entries.chinese_description: 将 Burn 451 稍后阅读应用中保存的书签作为知识库搜索、筛选和整理。

entries.chinese_description: 在 Claude Desktop 项目及多个 MCP 客户端之间交接对话上下文，存于内存而非文件。

entries.english_description: Chat with AI personas of famous founders and investors such as Elon Musk, Warren Buffett and Steve Jobs, based on their voices, frameworks and principles.
entries.chinese_description: 与基于 Elon Musk、Warren Buffett 和 Steve Jobs 等著名创始人及投资者声音、框架和原则构建的 AI 人格聊天。

entries.english_description: Local SQLite agent memory with a web dashboard, session rewind/replay, cross-client memory sharing, morning briefings and progressive context loading.
entries.chinese_description: 本地 SQLite 智能体记忆，提供 Web 仪表盘、会话倒退／重放、跨客户端记忆共享、晨间简报和渐进式上下文加载。

entries.english_description: Persistent knowledge memory for agents: read context into projects and write discoveries back, organized by topic with AES-256 encryption.
entries.chinese_description: 供智能体使用的持久知识记忆：将上下文读入项目并写回发现，按主题组织，使用 AES-256 加密。

entries.english_description: Persistent knowledge layer for agents: knowledge base, investigation threads and a journal with multi-agent attribution, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or Supabase.
entries.chinese_description: 供智能体使用的持久知识层：知识库、调查线程和带多智能体署名的日志，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 或 Supabase。

entries.english_description: Known dead ends for code errors and country-specific rules (visa, banking, legal): fixes that look right but fail, and workarounds with success rates.
entries.chinese_description: 记录代码错误及各国特定规则（签证、银行、法律）中的已知死路：看似正确却失败的修复方案，以及附成功率的替代方法。

entries.english_description: Record development decisions as structured JSON with Gemini embeddings and search them semantically from a local store shared across AI tools.
entries.chinese_description: 将开发决策记录为带 Gemini 嵌入的结构化 JSON，并从跨 AI 工具共享的本地存储进行语义搜索。

entries.english_description: Personal document vault on Azure Blob Storage: read, write and search plaintext docs, while client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted docs stay opaque.
entries.chinese_description: 基于 Azure Blob Storage 的个人文档库：读写搜索明文文档，而客户端 AES-256-GCM 加密文档保持不可见。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted knowledge backend for agents with hybrid vector and keyword search and container-isolated indexes.
entries.chinese_description: 供智能体使用的自托管知识后端，提供向量与关键词混合搜索和容器隔离索引。

entries.english_description: Annotate papers in Zotero: highlight key findings with semantic color coding, explain formulas and write structured reading notes.
entries.chinese_description: 在 Zotero 中批注论文：使用语义颜色突出关键发现、解释公式并编写结构化阅读笔记。

entries.english_description: Desktop app that captures screen activity, stores AI summaries and OCR text locally, and exposes the history via semantic search and a timeline.
entries.chinese_description: 捕获屏幕活动的桌面应用，将 AI 摘要和 OCR 文本存储在本地，并通过语义搜索和时间线提供历史记录。

entries.english_description: One wiki that all your agents read and write over MCP, from any machine: search, read, write, edit and move Markdown pages, with every version kept and the agent behind each change recorded. A web app shows the link graph and page history. Self-host it (AGPL-3.0) or use the hosted app.dexio.wiki.
entries.chinese_description: 供所有智能体在任意机器上通过 MCP 读写的统一 Wiki：搜索、读取、编写、编辑及移动 Markdown 页面，保留每个版本并记录每次变更的智能体。Web 应用展示链接图和页面历史；可自托管（AGPL-3.0）或使用托管的 app.dexio.wiki。

entries.english_description: Organizational knowledge base: Markdown docs, PostgreSQL tables and files linked by a URI graph, with hybrid search, Git history and multi-tenant ACLs.
entries.chinese_description: 组织知识库：以 URI 图链接 Markdown 文档、PostgreSQL 表和文件，支持混合搜索、Git 历史和多租户 ACL。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted documentation indexer that serves docs from various sources to agents with semantic search.
entries.chinese_description: 自托管文档索引器，以语义搜索方式向智能体提供不同来源的文档。

entries.english_description: Static server providing persistent tool-specific context and rules to AI models.
entries.chinese_description: 向 AI 模型提供持久的工具专属上下文和规则的静态服务器。

entries.english_description: Memory service with semantic search, persistent storage and autonomous memory consolidation.
entries.chinese_description: 提供语义搜索、持久存储和自主记忆整合的记忆服务。

entries.english_description: Local Obsidian vault access working directly on Markdown files without the Obsidian app or plugins, with read-only mode, backup-on-write and path isolation.
entries.chinese_description: 直接操作 Markdown 文件的本地 Obsidian 仓库访问，无需 Obsidian 应用或插件，支持只读模式、写入时备份和路径隔离。

entries.english_description: Reusable personas, skills, templates, agents and memory for AI clients, with dynamic permissions, versioning and a public collection of shareable content.
entries.chinese_description: 供 AI 客户端使用的可复用人格、技能、模板、智能体和记忆，支持动态权限、版本管理及公开的可分享内容集。

entries.english_description: Learning engine for Claude Code: extracts signals from sessions, runs periodic reflections and promotes or retires behavioral frameworks based on evidence.
entries.chinese_description: Claude Code 学习引擎：从会话提取信号、定期反思，并根据证据提升或淘汰行为框架。

entries.english_description: Reversibly compress large tool outputs into recoverable handles, expand them on demand and track token and cost savings locally.
entries.chinese_description: 将大型工具输出可逆压缩为可恢复句柄，按需展开，并在本地跟踪 token 和成本节省。

entries.english_description: Shared versioned state store with optimistic concurrency control for coordinating concurrent agents, plus SQLite-backed claim/release locks and an audit log.
entries.chinese_description: 带乐观并发控制的共享版本化状态库，用于协调并发智能体，并提供基于 SQLite 的认领／释放锁和审计日志。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted mem0 for Claude Code: Qdrant vector search, Neo4j knowledge graph, Ollama embeddings and session hooks for automatic cross-session memory.
entries.chinese_description: 为 Claude Code 自托管 mem0：Qdrant 向量搜索、Neo4j 知识图、Ollama 嵌入及用于跨会话自动记忆的会话钩子。

entries.english_description: Zettelkasten knowledge management: create, link and search atomic notes.
entries.chinese_description: Zettelkasten 知识管理：创建、链接和搜索原子笔记。

entries.english_description: Three-layer agent memory (identity, active, archive) with semantic search, graph relationships and conflict detection.
entries.chinese_description: 三层智能体记忆（身份、活跃、归档），支持语义搜索、图关系和冲突检测。

entries.english_description: Refocuses an agent that has lost its thread by distilling its original purpose, paid per use via Lightning or Arbitrum.
entries.chinese_description: 通过提炼原始目标，让偏离思路的智能体重新聚焦；通过 Lightning 或 Arbitrum 按使用付费。

entries.english_description: Persistent, searchable context storage across Claude Code sessions using SQLite FTS5, with AI session summaries, checkpoint recovery and a web dashboard.
entries.chinese_description: 使用 SQLite FTS5 跨 Claude Code 会话保存可搜索的持久上下文，支持 AI 会话摘要、检查点恢复和 Web 仪表盘。

entries.english_description: Local-first memory for Claude Code and Codex: hooks capture sessions and an LLM distills them into SQLite, with auditable full-text and embedding recall.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的本地优先记忆：钩子捕获会话，LLM 将其提炼到 SQLite，提供可审计的全文及嵌入召回。

entries.english_description: Compresses AI chat sessions into a compact typed knowledge graph, with optional offline extraction via Ollama.
entries.chinese_description: 将 AI 聊天会话压缩为精简的类型化知识图，可选通过 Ollama 离线提取。

entries.english_description: Long-term memory shared by every AI coding assistant on one machine: a single local SQLite file with FTS5 search and optional multilingual semantic search, no daemon and no cloud, reachable over MCP, a CLI or plain SQLite.
entries.chinese_description: 一台机器上所有 AI 编码助手共享的长期记忆：单个本地 SQLite 文件，支持 FTS5 搜索和可选多语言语义搜索，无守护进程和云端，可通过 MCP、CLI 或普通 SQLite 访问。

entries.english_description: Read and write notes in your Obsidian vault.
entries.chinese_description: 读取和写入 Obsidian 仓库中的笔记。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted memory and governance for coding agents: structured knowledge capture, hybrid search with reranking, codebase analysis and git-native storage.
entries.chinese_description: 面向编码智能体的自托管记忆与治理：结构化知识采集、带重排序的混合搜索、代码库分析及 Git 原生存储。

entries.english_description: Ontology engineering for OWL, RDF and SPARQL: validate, query, diff, lint, version and govern knowledge graphs on an Oxigraph triple store.
entries.chinese_description: 针对 OWL、RDF 和 SPARQL 的本体工程：在 Oxigraph 三元组存储上验证、查询、比较、检查、版本化和治理知识图。

entries.english_description: Full-text and semantic search over Claude Code transcript history, with exact thread recall and durable remembered facts in local SQLite.
entries.chinese_description: 对 Claude Code 会话记录历史执行全文和语义搜索，在本地 SQLite 中精确召回线程并持久保存事实。

entries.english_description: Encrypted local memory for Claude Code Telegram bots: captures both sides of conversations, with SQLCipher encryption and CJK-friendly full-text search.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 Claude Code Telegram 机器人的加密本地记忆：捕获对话双方内容，支持 SQLCipher 加密和对中日韩友好的全文搜索。

entries.english_description: Persistent semantic memory for agents with quality-gated writes, typed claims, conflict tracking and coherence scoring.
entries.chinese_description: 供智能体使用的持久语义记忆，支持质量门控写入、类型化声明、冲突跟踪和一致性评分。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted Markdown knowledge base with a web UI: search, read, create, edit, tag and template notes.
entries.chinese_description: 带 Web 界面的自托管 Markdown 知识库：搜索、读取、创建、编辑、标记和模板化笔记。

entries.english_description: Local-first shared memory and coordination for coding agents on PostgreSQL/pgvector: repository evidence, reservations, handoffs and code graph context.
entries.chinese_description: 基于 PostgreSQL/pgvector、供编码智能体共享的本地优先记忆与协调：仓库证据、预留、交接和代码图上下文。

entries.english_description: Local SQLite memory for coding assistants: typed memories with confidence lifecycle, namespaces, knowledge graph, hybrid search and keychain credential vault.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码助手使用的本地 SQLite 记忆：带置信度生命周期的类型化记忆、命名空间、知识图、混合搜索和密钥链凭据库。

entries.english_description: Manage personal knowledge, daily notes and reusable prompts in GitHub Gists, as a companion to GistPad.
entries.chinese_description: 在 GitHub Gist 中管理个人知识、每日笔记和可复用提示词，作为 GistPad 的配套工具。

entries.english_description: Knowledge marketplace where agents search, publish and unlock previously solved problems, earning tokens for shared solutions.
entries.chinese_description: 知识市场，智能体可搜索、发布和解锁先前解决的问题，并因分享解决方案赚取 token。

entries.english_description: One local memory shared by every coding agent and model on your PC: every conversation saved verbatim with zero LLM calls, recalled as a ~3k-token evidence packet (88.8% on LongMemEval), secrets masked, shareable across your PCs.
entries.chinese_description: PC 上所有编码智能体和模型共享的一份本地记忆：不调用 LLM 即逐字保存每次对话，并以约 3,000 token 的证据包召回（LongMemEval 88.8%）；遮盖密钥并可在个人电脑之间共享。

entries.english_description: LEGO sets, parts, minifigs and inventories from Rebrickable: search and compare sets, find parts by colour, browse themes and discover alternate builds.
entries.chinese_description: 来自 Rebrickable 的 LEGO 套装、零件、迷你人偶及库存：搜索和比较套装、按颜色查找零件、浏览主题并发现替代拼搭。

entries.english_description: Brewing knowledge: BJCP 2021 beer styles, hop varieties, malts, yeasts, water profiles, off-flavour diagnosis, recipe suggestions and food pairings.
entries.chinese_description: 酿造知识：BJCP 2021 啤酒风格、啤酒花品种、麦芽、酵母、水质参数、异味诊断、配方建议和食物搭配。

entries.english_description: 3D printing filament knowledge base from SpoolmanDB: search filaments, compare material properties and print settings, and diagnose print issues.
entries.chinese_description: 来自 SpoolmanDB 的 3D 打印耗材知识库：搜索耗材、比较材料属性和打印设置，并诊断打印问题。

entries.english_description: Offline persistent agent memory on SQLite with local embeddings, hybrid semantic and full-text recall, secret detection and contradiction handling.
entries.chinese_description: 基于 SQLite 的离线持久智能体记忆，使用本地嵌入、语义与全文混合召回、密钥检测和矛盾处理。

entries.english_description: Access RAGStack serverless knowledge bases on AWS: search, chat with AI answers, upload documents and media, scrape websites and analyze metadata.
entries.chinese_description: 访问 AWS 上的 RAGStack 无服务器知识库：搜索、AI 问答、上传文档和媒体、抓取网站并分析元数据。

entries.english_description: Local-first memory with verbatim recall, querying, health checks and context-sensitive orientation, using LLM-free retrieval by default.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先记忆，支持逐字召回、查询、健康检查及上下文感知的方向提示，默认使用无需 LLM 的检索。

entries.english_description: Cloud-based persistent memory for Claude Code with semantic search, AI extraction and project scoping.
entries.chinese_description: 供 Claude Code 使用的云端持久记忆，支持语义搜索、AI 提取和项目范围隔离。

entries.english_description: Cloud or self-hosted knowledge workspace with hybrid document search, GraphRAG, and scoped MCP tools for reading and updating documents.
entries.chinese_description: 云端或自托管知识工作区，提供混合文档搜索、GraphRAG 和用于读写更新文档的范围化 MCP 工具。

entries.english_description: Local-first, auditable memory with scoped user/project storage in SQLite or Postgres, read-only recall by default and opt-in reviewed writeback.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先、可审计的记忆，按用户／项目范围存于 SQLite 或 Postgres，默认只读召回，可主动启用经审查的写回。

entries.english_description: Read, create, update, comment on and share AgentDocs Markdown docs, with full-text and semantic search.
entries.chinese_description: 读取、创建、更新、评论和分享 AgentDocs Markdown 文档，支持全文及语义搜索。

entries.english_description: Reasoning via a DAG thought graph with multiple strategies (dialectic, analogical, abductive and more), stuck detection, confidence scoring and self-critique.
entries.chinese_description: 通过 DAG 思维图进行推理，支持辩证、类比、溯因等多种策略，以及卡住检测、置信度评分和自我批评。

entries.english_description: Local semantic search across Claude Code conversations with hybrid vector and keyword search, background indexing and per-project selection.
entries.chinese_description: 对 Claude Code 对话进行本地语义搜索，支持向量与关键词混合搜索、后台索引及按项目选择。

entries.english_description: Agent memory with a correction channel: supersede or revert stale facts, block restated old values, and prove deletions with signed tombstones.
entries.chinese_description: 带修正通道的智能体记忆：替代或还原过期事实、阻止重新陈述旧值，并使用签名墓碑证明删除。

entries.english_description: Browse and search open-source bounties on Algora, filter by org, tech or amount, and get top bounties and aggregate stats.
entries.chinese_description: 在 Algora 浏览和搜索开源悬赏，按组织、技术或金额筛选，并获取热门悬赏及汇总统计。

entries.english_description: Pre-action gates that prevent coding agents from repeating known mistakes by turning captured feedback and failures into rules enforced via hooks.
entries.chinese_description: 行动前门控，将捕获的反馈和失败转化为通过钩子执行的规则，防止编码智能体重复已知错误。

entries.english_description: Agent failure memory: search verified debugging lessons from real engineering sessions.
entries.chinese_description: 智能体失败记忆：搜索来自真实工程会话、经验证的调试经验。

entries.english_description: Local-first governed shared memory for coding agents with CLI and desktop console: classify, dedupe, supersede, quarantine and roll back memories.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的本地优先、受治理共享记忆，提供 CLI 和桌面控制台，可分类、去重、替代、隔离及回滚记忆。

entries.english_description: Pull request contribution advisor based on case studies from real repos: merge probability analysis, pattern matching and contribution strategy.
entries.chinese_description: 基于真实仓库案例的拉取请求贡献顾问：合并概率分析、模式匹配及贡献策略。

entries.english_description: A provenance tree for coding agents: every node records the node it was born from, so the agent can ask why the work is where it is. A session brief with the standing decisions and what not to touch, a close that refuses over open work, and decisions kept with the alternatives they rejected. Local JSON-lines file, no telemetry.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的来源树：每个节点记录其来源节点，使智能体能追问工作为何处于当前状态。提供包含既定决策和禁止触碰内容的会话简报，在仍有未完成工作时拒绝关闭，并将决策与其拒绝的替代方案一同保存；使用本地 JSON Lines 文件，无遥测。

entries.english_description: Vectorless, structure-first retrieval over large Markdown libraries: walk library, folder, document and section trees, read original text with line numbers for citations, and fall back to mixed Chinese/English BM25 search. Five read-only tools, no embeddings, no API key.
entries.chinese_description: 对大型 Markdown 库进行无向量、结构优先的检索：遍历库、文件夹、文档和章节树，读取带行号的原文供引用，并在需要时回退到中英混合 BM25 搜索。五个只读工具，无嵌入，无需 API 密钥。

entries.english_description: Minimal local RAG that vector-searches a document corpus and returns cited passages.
entries.chinese_description: 最小化本地 RAG，对文档语料进行向量搜索并返回附引用段落。

entries.english_description: Read Markdown with inlined images and heading indexes for agentic RAG over local docs or allowed URLs.
entries.chinese_description: 读取带内嵌图片和标题索引的 Markdown，用于本地文档或允许的 URL 上的智能体 RAG。

entries.english_description: Persistent engineering knowledge base with source-backed wiki, agent-runtime and repository-context tools, contradiction and staleness checks, and PIN-gated private scopes and writes.
entries.chinese_description: 持久工程知识库，提供有来源支持的 Wiki、智能体运行时和仓库上下文工具，支持矛盾及过期检查，以及 PIN 门控的私有范围和写入。

entries.english_description: Simple memory for coding agents using DuckDB and VoyageAI.
entries.chinese_description: 使用 DuckDB 和 VoyageAI 为编码智能体提供简易记忆。

entries.english_description: Local-first semantic memory: hybrid search, Markdown storage, MLX or CPU embeddings, contradiction detection, time-travel history and cross-machine git sync.
entries.chinese_description: 本地优先语义记忆：混合搜索、Markdown 存储、MLX 或 CPU 嵌入、矛盾检测、时间旅行历史及跨机器 Git 同步。

entries.english_description: Checks a folder of Markdown docs for missing Open Knowledge Format (OKF) frontmatter fields, locally; writes only .jidoseal/ in that folder. MCP server Apache-2.0, scan engine proprietary; no network use during a scan is a vendor claim.
entries.chinese_description: 在本地检查 Markdown 文档文件夹是否缺少开放知识格式（OKF）的 frontmatter 字段；只在该文件夹内写入 .jidoseal/。MCP 服务器采用 Apache-2.0，扫描引擎为专有软件；扫描期间不使用网络是供应商的声明。

entries.english_description: Shared community repository of insights, decisions, warnings and patterns with semantic search, a 3D interactive globe and automated content moderation.
entries.chinese_description: 共享社区仓库，收录洞察、决策、警告和模式，支持语义搜索、3D 交互地球和自动内容审核。

entries.english_description: Graph-native Obsidian vault access: search, backlinks, n-hop neighborhoods, paginated reads and safe partial and bulk edits with dry-run and rollback.
entries.chinese_description: 图原生 Obsidian 仓库访问：搜索、反向链接、n 跳邻域、分页读取，以及带试运行和回滚的安全局部与批量编辑。

entries.english_description: Hierarchical agent memory engine with automatic decay, promotion, semantic deduplication and a self-organizing topic tree.
entries.chinese_description: 分层智能体记忆引擎，支持自动衰减、提升、语义去重和自组织主题树。

entries.english_description: Git-native memory for coding agents: JSON entries in the repo, verified against cited code so hallucinated citations are rejected and stale memory is withheld.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的 Git 原生记忆：仓库中的 JSON 条目会根据引用代码验证，拒绝编造的引用并隐藏过期记忆。

entries.english_description: Memory for coding agents built around corrections: distills your corrections into standing rules for later sessions, with isolated memory per project.
entries.chinese_description: 以修正为中心的编码智能体记忆：将用户修正提炼成后续会话的长期规则，并按项目隔离记忆。

entries.english_description: Local-first personal CRM that keeps your contacts as plain Markdown files. entries.english_description: Generates a Git-versioned Markdown vault as project memory, then serves it over MCP. `recall` returns a project's capsule plus the read-next list and warns when the capsule is older than the decisions beneath it; `search` ranks by layer; writes are scoped — `update_capsule` replaces one named section rather than rewriting the file. A `doctor` tool validates that every link resolves and every project is reachable, so the memory fails loudly instead of rotting. Plain Markdown, Obsidian-compatible, no database. `npx @sunsato/vulcanus`
entries.chinese_description: 生成由 Git 版本管理的 Markdown 仓库作为项目记忆，并通过 MCP 提供。`recall` 返回项目摘要胶囊和下一步阅读列表，当摘要早于其下决策时发出警告；`search` 按层排序；写入限定范围，`update_capsule` 仅替换一个指定章节而非重写文件。`doctor` 工具验证每个链接均可解析、每个项目均可访问，使记忆损坏时明确报错。纯 Markdown，兼容 Obsidian，无数据库。`npx @sunsato/vulcanus`

entries.english_description: Local-first memory for AI coding agents on SQLite/FTS5, curated and semantically de-duplicated, with data stored as plain rows you own.

entries.english_description: Local-first memory for AI agents in one SQLite file: hybrid BM25 and on-device embedding search with reranking, abstaining instead of returning wrong memories.

entries.english_description: Local-first memory for AI agent teams: private, team and project access control, associative recall and federated sync with revocation, plus a web console.
entries.chinese_description: 面向 AI 智能体团队的本地优先记忆：私有、团队和项目访问控制、关联召回及支持撤销的联合同步，并提供 Web 控制台。

entries.english_description: Loads a personal profile mined from your local Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode logs so agents work the way you do.
entries.chinese_description: 加载从本地 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 日志中挖掘的个人资料，让智能体按照你的方式工作。

entries.chinese_description: 将项目工作状态（文件、Git、计划、决策）快照为单个上下文对象，使会话可在智能体间迁移；本地且只读。

entries.english_description: Hosted agent memory with an audit trail: writes carry provenance, contradictions surface as inspectable changes, and bad runs are recovered from snapshots.
entries.chinese_description: 带审计轨迹的托管智能体记忆：写入附带来源，矛盾以可检查变更形式显示，异常运行可从快照恢复。

entries.english_description: Correlates failed shell commands and their exit codes with whatever later fixed them, alongside git diffs and docs, stored locally in SQLite.
entries.chinese_description: 将失败的 Shell 命令及退出码与后来修复它们的操作相关联，并保存 Git 差异和文档，数据存于本地 SQLite。

entries.english_description: Lossless archive and search for AI agent sessions across clients.

entries.english_description: Persistent memory for coding agents in plain repo files (AGENTS.md, issues.jsonl): captures bugs, fixes, decisions and corrections and recalls them later.
entries.chinese_description: 以仓库内纯文件（AGENTS.md、issues.jsonl）为编码智能体提供持久记忆：捕获缺陷、修复、决策及更正并在之后召回。

entries.english_description: Local memory shared by all coding agents on a machine, built from sessions, commits, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md and ADRs, with claims that lock in-progress work.
entries.chinese_description: 机器上所有编码智能体共享的本地记忆，基于会话、提交、CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md 和 ADR 构建，支持认领并锁定进行中的工作。

entries.english_description: Git-native Markdown content CLI: search, read, write and govern story, paper and note repos, generate READMEs, export EPUB and prepare training data.
entries.chinese_description: Git 原生 Markdown 内容 CLI：搜索、读取、编写和治理故事、论文及笔记仓库，生成 README、导出 EPUB 和准备训练数据。

entries.english_description: Search, read and edit a self-hosted Wiki.js 2.x, including assets, comments, users and groups, with full-text grep, overwrite protection and a read-only mode.
entries.chinese_description: 搜索、读取和编辑自托管 Wiki.js 2.x，包括素材、评论、用户和群组，支持全文 grep、覆盖保护和只读模式。

entries.english_description: Long-term memory over a folder of Markdown files: local hybrid retrieval (BM25F, dense vectors, phrase proximity) that reports when an answer is absent.
entries.chinese_description: 基于 Markdown 文件夹的长期记忆：本地混合检索（BM25F、稠密向量、短语邻近度），并报告答案不存在的情况。

entries.english_description: Persistent memory with swappable Postgres/pgvector, Qdrant or Neo4j backends, adaptive retrieval weighting, duplicate merging and stale-fact archiving.
entries.chinese_description: 持久记忆，支持可替换的 Postgres/pgvector、Qdrant 或 Neo4j 后端、自适应检索权重、重复项合并和过期事实归档。

entries.english_description: Turns your Instagram saved posts into a local, searchable knowledge base, with AI-extracted summaries, key points, how-tos, links and tags in SQLite.
entries.chinese_description: 将 Instagram 收藏帖子转为本地可搜索知识库，使用 SQLite 保存 AI 提取的摘要、要点、操作指南、链接和标签。

entries.english_description: Human-governed memory in local, domain-separated vaults with hybrid retrieval; also reads other coding agents' output. Requires the Mnemosyne OS desktop app.
entries.chinese_description: 受人工治理的本地域隔离知识库记忆，支持混合检索，也可读取其他编码智能体的输出；需要 Mnemosyne OS 桌面应用。

entries.english_description: Self-improving skill memory for coding agents: useful skills are reinforced, unused ones fade; local English/Russian hybrid search, tamper-evident history.

entries.english_description: Queryable second brain over your scattered notes, docs, PDFs and chat exports: hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 fused with RRF), section-level citations with an optional claim-by-claim verification pass, and an Obsidian-style wikilink graph — all local, any OpenAI-compatible API or fully offline via Ollama. `pip install loci-rag` then run `loci-mcp`.
entries.chinese_description: 对分散的笔记、文档、PDF 和聊天导出内容提供可查询第二大脑：混合检索（向量 + BM25 并用 RRF 融合）、章节级引用及可选逐声明核验，并提供 Obsidian 风格 Wiki 链接图；全部本地，可使用任意 OpenAI 兼容 API 或通过 Ollama 完全离线。`pip install loci-rag`，然后运行 `loci-mcp`。

entries.english_description: Seven-layer local agent memory that routes input into facts, episodes or procedures, searches all layers and consolidates repeated episodes into facts.
entries.chinese_description: 七层本地智能体记忆，将输入路由为事实、情景或程序，搜索所有层，并将重复情景整合为事实。

entries.english_description: Persistent local memory for coding agents that retires replaced facts at write time, so agents read the current answer; facts are typed with provenance.
entries.chinese_description: 供编码智能体使用的本地持久记忆，在写入时淘汰被替代的事实，使智能体读取当前答案；事实带类型和来源。

entries.english_description: Self-hosted shared brain for multiple agents: Git-versioned Markdown knowledge plus a task queue with atomic claims, per-space ACL, audit log and human approval, so Claude, ChatGPT and other agents can hand work to each other.

entries.english_description: Official Telys MCP server — private, on-device memory & retrieval for AI assistants: 19 tools covering memory CRUD, semantic + on-device BM25 lexical search, single-key filtered queries, compaction/IVF/tuning maintenance, and a self-refreshing repo auto-indexer. Stdio; introspection needs no credentials; execution requires the one-time free `telys login` (device authorization). `pipx install telys`

entries.english_description: Shared, serverless, conflict-free memory for AI agents: a multi-machine drop-in for the MCP memory knowledge graph, converging per-node shards with no server.
